result.instructions: Tools for MailReach, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our sending domains has the lowest deliverability score this month?"; "Are any of our email accounts on a blacklist, and which one?"; "Run a spam test on our newsletter and show me the inbox placement once it finishes.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MailReach data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailreach_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailreach_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailreach_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mailreach_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailreach_list_domains
tools.title: List sending domains
tools.description: List every unique sending domain in the project with its average deliverability score. Domains with no computed score are omitted. Good first call to see what is monitored. GET /v1/projects/domains.

order.description: Sort order of the domain list.

tools.name: mailreach_get_project_stats
tools.title: Get project statistics
tools.description: Aggregated sending, reception and spam statistics across the project's accounts, filtered by domains. Use 'all' for every account. Data is available up to 2 days ago. GET /v1/stats.

domains.description: Comma-separated domains (or substrings) to filter accounts by email, or 'all'.

past_days.description: Number of past days to include in the statistics.

tools.name: mailreach_list_accounts
tools.title: List email accounts
tools.description: List the connected email accounts in the project, with their reputation score and status. Filter by search text, tag, or score. GET /v1/accounts.

tags.description: Filter by tag names (as the API expects them).

max_score.description: Only accounts with a score at or below this value.

spamchecker_only.description: Only accounts used for spam checks.

tools.name: mailreach_get_account
tools.title: Get an email account
tools.description: Retrieve one connected email account: its status, warming mode, score and domain. GET /v1/accounts/{id}.

tools.name: mailreach_get_account_stats
tools.title: Get account statistics
tools.description: Deliverability statistics for one email account over the past days, optionally for one provider. GET /v1/accounts/{id}/stats.

past_days.description: Number of past days to include in the statistics.

tools.name: mailreach_list_account_aliases
tools.title: List account aliases
tools.description: List the alias addresses that send or receive through one email account. GET /v1/accounts/{id}/aliases.

tools.name: mailreach_get_domain_blacklists
tools.title: Get domain blacklists
tools.description: Domain blacklist hits for one email account's domain (the blacklists that list the sending domain). GET /v1/domain_blacklists/{account_id}.

tools.name: mailreach_list_spam_tests
tools.title: List spam tests
tools.description: List spam tests in the project with their scores and status. Page through results with 'page'. GET /v1/spam_tests.

automated_test_id.description: Only spam tests produced by this automated test.

tools.name: mailreach_get_spam_test
tools.title: Get a spam test result
tools.description: Full result of one spam test: inbox placement, blacklists, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results and content analysis. Poll this after the test email reaches the seedlist. GET /v1/spam_tests/{public_id}.

public_id.description: Public id of a spam test (the public_id returned when the test was created).

tools.name: mailreach_get_spam_test_blacklists
tools.title: Get spam test blacklists
tools.description: Blacklist hits found by one spam test (sending IP and links). GET /v1/spam_tests/{public_id}/blacklists.

public_id.description: Public id of a spam test (the public_id returned when the test was created).

tools.name: mailreach_create_spam_test
tools.title: Create a spam test
tools.description: Create a one-time spam test and get the seedlist recipients and public_full_id. Each test uses one Spam Checker credit (not charged if results fail to collect). The customer then sends the email; this tool does not send mail. POST /v1/spam_tests.

seedlist.description: Seedlist variant 1-4 (default 1). Rotating variants reduces skew.

tools.name: mailreach_list_notifications
tools.title: List open notifications
tools.description: List open notifications (disconnected accounts, reputation drops, missing inbound mail and similar events). GET /v1/notifications.

event.description: Only notifications of this event type.

tools.name: mailreach_summarize_notifications
tools.title: Summarize open notifications
tools.description: Count of open notifications by event type. Good first call to see what needs attention. GET /v1/notifications/summary.

tools.name: mailreach_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List the project's alert rules (which events notify which channel). GET /v1/alerts.

automated_test_id.description: Only alerts for this automated test.

event.description: Only alerts for this event type.

tools.name: mailreach_list_automated_tests
tools.title: List automated tests
tools.description: List scheduled automated spam tests, optionally only active ones. GET /v1/automated_tests.

tools.name: mailreach_get_automated_test
tools.title: Get an automated test
tools.description: Retrieve one automated spam test: its schedule, seedlist and latest result. GET /v1/automated_tests/{id}.

tools.name: mailreach_list_email_workspaces
tools.title: List email workspaces
tools.description: List the email workspaces (Google or Outlook tenants) connected to the project. GET /v1/email_workspaces.

tools.name: mailreach_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the project's tags, used to group accounts. GET /v1/tags.

is_provider.description: Only provider tags (true) or only custom tags (false).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with MailReach
prompts.description: What you can do with MailReach here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_weakest_sending_domain
prompts.title: Find the weakest sending domain
prompts.description: List the sending domains with their average deliverability score. Read sending and spam statistics for chosen domains.

prompts.name: check_email_accounts_for_blacklist_hits
prompts.title: Check email accounts for blacklist hits
prompts.description: List the connected email accounts with their reputation scores. Read the blacklists that list the sending domain of one account.

prompts.name: review_open_notifications_and_alerts
prompts.title: Review open notifications and alerts
prompts.description: Count the open notifications by event type, then list those that need attention. List the alert rules too.

prompts.name: run_a_spam_test_and_read_the_result
prompts.title: Run a spam test and read the result
prompts.description: Create a one-time spam test to get the seedlist recipients. The customer sends the email; the tool does not. Read the result after it arrives.

prompts.name: review_scheduled_automated_tests
prompts.title: Review scheduled automated tests
prompts.description: List the scheduled spam tests, optionally only the active ones. Read one test with its schedule and latest result.
